title: Sophia Laforteza steps away from Katseye, the second member to depart this year
facts: Katseye vocalist Sophia Laforteza announced a temporary hiatus from the music group to address mental health concerns.
Katseye is managed by the record label HYBE x Geffen Records.
Sophia Laforteza is a Filipino-American pop artist.
HYBE x Geffen Records announced that Sophia Laforteza's health condition will be reassessed in September.
Katseye bandmate Manon Bannerman previously announced a hiatus from the group in February.
Manon Bannerman is a 23-year-old Swiss singer.
Katseye originally formed as a six-member music ensemble in 2023.
Katseye earned two Grammy Award nominations last year.
Following Sophia Laforteza's departure, Katseye will continue performing as a four-member group.
Katseye's musical releases include the international tracks 'Gnarly', 'Pinky Up', and 'Gabriela'.
Members of Katseye reported receiving online death threats following their musical debut.
Sophia Laforteza released a statement on Instagram addressing her decision to prioritize her health.
HYBE x Geffen Records stated that Sophia Laforteza had been consulting medical professionals regarding her recovery.
The record label stated that the door remains open for Manon Bannerman to return to the group.
Katseye members reached the hiatus decisions through internal group discussions.
